name: Environment Matrix Generator

# Triggers: run on every push / PR, allow manual dispatch, and a weekly
# scheduled sanity check that the matrix generator still produces valid output.
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      config_file:
        description: "Path to the matrix configuration JSON file"
        required: false
        default: fixtures/matrix.json
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

# Principle of least privilege: the workflow only needs to read the repository.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Config file the generator reads. The test harness overwrites this fixture
  # per test case so the same workflow can exercise many inputs.
  CONFIG_FILE: ${{ github.event.inputs.config_file || 'fixtures/matrix.json' }}

jobs:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: generate the build matrix from the configuration file.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.gen.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run unit tests (TDD suite)
        run: |
          "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" test

      - name: Generate matrix
        id: gen
        # The CLI prints the strategy JSON to stdout AND appends a `matrix=...`
        # step output to $GITHUB_OUTPUT for the downstream build job to consume.
        run: |
          "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" run src/cli.ts "$CONFIG_FILE" --pretty | tee matrix.json

      - name: Show matrix output
        # Clearly delimited so the act-based test harness can extract and assert
        # on the exact generated JSON.
        run: |
          echo "MATRIX_OUTPUT_START"
          cat matrix.json
          echo "MATRIX_OUTPUT_END"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 2: consume the generated matrix in a real fan-out build job.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Report combination
        run: |
          echo "BUILD os=${{ matrix.os }} language=${{ matrix.language }} feature=${{ matrix.feature }}"

name: Environment Matrix Generator

# Triggers: run on every push / PR, allow manual dispatch, and a weekly
# scheduled sanity check that the matrix generator still produces valid output.
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      config_file:
        description: "Path to the matrix configuration JSON file"
        required: false
        default: fixtures/matrix.json
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

# Principle of least privilege: the workflow only needs to read the repository.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Config file the generator reads. The test harness overwrites this fixture
  # per test case so the same workflow can exercise many inputs.
  CONFIG_FILE: ${{ github.event.inputs.config_file || 'fixtures/matrix.json' }}

jobs:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: generate the build matrix from the configuration file.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.gen.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run unit tests (TDD suite)
        # Only the pure-logic suites run inside the container. The workflow
        # structure tests (which shell out to actionlint) and the act harness
        # (which needs Docker) are host-only and excluded here on purpose.
        run: |
          "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" test tests/matrix.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts

      - name: Generate matrix
        id: gen
        # The CLI prints the strategy JSON to stdout AND appends a `matrix=...`
        # step output to $GITHUB_OUTPUT for the downstream build job to consume.
        run: |
          "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" run src/cli.ts "$CONFIG_FILE" --pretty | tee matrix.json

      - name: Show matrix output
        # Clearly delimited so the act-based test harness can extract and assert
        # on the exact generated JSON.
        run: |
          echo "MATRIX_OUTPUT_START"
          cat matrix.json
          echo "MATRIX_OUTPUT_END"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 2: consume the generated matrix in a real fan-out build job.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Report combination
        run: |
          echo "BUILD os=${{ matrix.os }} language=${{ matrix.language }} feature=${{ matrix.feature }}"
